subject: Three switch silhouettes in a row sharing one continuous housing outline: a single long top-housing trapezoid and bottom housing spanning all three bays with dashed partitions, a tactile stem with a D-shaped plateau on its flanks, a silent tactile stem with the same plateau plus a foam ring on the housing floor and small pads at its feet, and a linear stem with straight flanks. Each bay has a leaf contact, spring stack and center post. Coral splash under the middle silhouette.
background: transparent (light-mode safe; previewed on the charcoal oklch(0.175 0.006 250) and legible)
notes: Housing: top trapezoid x 176 to 1024 at y 250 widening to x 150 to 1050 at y 340, bottom housing x 166 to 1034, y 340 to 560, both with inner walls, dashed bay partitions at x 450 and 750, clip nubs at the ends, a pair of PCB pins per bay. Stems centered x 300 / 600 / 900: cruciform heads y 200 to 230, bodies 72 wide from y 250 to 460. Tactile and silent tactile stems carry the flat-topped rounded-corner plateau on both flanks at y 296 to 338 (the family's D-shaped bump per the U4T piece); the linear stem is a plain rectangle with a dashed flank reference where the plateau would be. Leaf contact stubs to the right of each stem, three-ellipse spring stacks y 472 to 494, center posts y 500 to 548. Tactile and linear bays carry an empty dashed ghost ring on the floor; the silent bay carries a solid foam ring (ellipse rx 44 ry 8 at y 536) filled in coral with an inner ring, plus two small coral foot pads at y 456. Coral oklch(0.68 0.165 28) reuses the U4T deep-dive's value deliberately as the family tie; applied as a wash ellipse under the middle bay (600,500), the foam ring and pad fills, the focal dot+ring on the ring (600,536), the SILENT TACTILE and FOAM RING labels. Bronze theme dot at (1148,92); three left-margin ticks. All XML comments use '==' separator runs (no '--' runs) per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard.
warnings: Labels reference IBM Plex Sans / JetBrains Mono by family name with system fallbacks; the SVG does not embed font files (family convention, matches prior hero-art).
Preview rasters were rendered with the repo's existing Playwright/Chromium install into the session scratchpad for visual QA only; nothing rasterized was written into the repo.
